record.summary: Passive.SEASONAL is declared by the four Deerling and four Sawsbuck forms (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter). The passive value itself is tested nowhere in the code read (the only references are the enum and the eight unit classes). What the code does with the seasons: when a game room is created and the special rule is not EVERYONE_IS_HERE, the server date decides a season and every Deerling form of the other three seasons is removed from the rare additional-pick pool. Each Deerling evolves into the Sawsbuck of the same season (separate unit classes with their own types: Spring Normal/Grass/Flora, Summer Normal/Grass/Gourmet, Autumn Normal/Grass/Wild, Winter Normal/Grass/Ice). The passive adds no combat effect that was found.
triggers: No trigger of its own (marker only)
Room creation: the season filter of additionalRarePool in GameRoom (not conditioned on the passive)

effects.declaredRaw: keep only the Deerling form matching the current season (spring Mar 20-Jun 21, summer Jun 22-Sep 22, autumn Sep 23-Dec 20, winter Dec 21-Mar 19) in the rare additional pool; no filter under EVERYONE_IS_HERE
effects.scaling: none (no AP, no crit, no combat effect)
effects.resolution: the remaining form is offered through the additional-pick stage that uses the rare pool; the evolved Sawsbuck of that season follows from the unit class 'evolution' fields

conditions: The season uses the server's current date at room creation (year-local Date objects), Northern Hemisphere boundaries as written in the comments
Under EVERYONE_IS_HERE all four Deerling forms stay in the pool
Only Deerling forms are filtered; Sawsbuck forms are not in the pool (they are 2-star), so they are reachable only by evolution

Types differ per season form (read from the unit classes): Spring Flora, Summer Gourmet, Autumn Wild, Winter Ice, each with Normal and Grass; stats are identical across seasons within a stage in the blocks read
record.resetBehaviour: No state on the unit; the form is the Pkm name chosen when the unit is created. The season is computed once per room creation.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: No combat behaviour of the passive was found; the units' ability is the separate HORN_LEECH record
